## 0. 重要更新说明

- **仅限仍在运行 v1.4.x 的 amd64 + Docker 控制面安装：**旧升级器会在新版本接管前固定请求
  ARM64 Control 镜像，因此需要先在主机执行一次下面的兼容引导，再从 WebUI 正常升级。
  ARM64、原生控制面以及已经运行 v1.5.x 的设备不需要执行。

  ```bash
  MDD_DATA_DIR=$(sudo sed -n '1p' /etc/mdd-sim-gateway/data-dir)
  test -n "$MDD_DATA_DIR" && test -d "$MDD_DATA_DIR"
  sudo cp -p "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode" "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode.pre-v1.5.3"
  printf 'local\n' | sudo tee "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode" >/dev/null
  ```

  v1.5.3 接管后会识别仍在运行的 Docker 控制面，下载 amd64 Engine 与 Control，并自动恢复
  Docker 模式。若新版本接管前升级已经失败，可执行
  `sudo cp "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode.pre-v1.5.3" "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode"` 恢复标记。

- 首次从 v1.4.x 跨级升级或全新安装时，会下载与主机架构匹配的 Engine 镜像；Docker 控制面
  还会下载 Control 镜像。网络较慢时，“正在重建并重启服务”可能持续数分钟，请勿断电、刷新
  后重复发起升级或手工终止更新。升级前请确认根文件系统约有 **6 GiB 可用空间**。
- v1.5.3 没有改变 v1.5.2 的 Engine 构建输入；已经运行 v1.5.2 的设备会复用现有 Engine，
  不会为这次升级重建线路。Docker 控制面仍需更新 Control 镜像。

## 1. v1.5.3 小版本更新

- ARM64 与 amd64 现在都有原生预构建的 Engine 和 Control 镜像。正式安装和一键升级只下载
  当前架构，不再让网关本机编译 Asterisk 或 Docker Control。
- 修复 Issue #17、#18：兼容 Ubuntu 22.04 / ModemManager 1.20 的蜂窝短信发送，并统一处理
  ICCID 大小写差异，避免找不到正确蜂窝模块。
- 修复 Issue #19：关闭 VoWiFi 时插入新 SIM 不再把线路永久留在无法启用的草稿状态。
- 修复 Issue #15：旧升级器首次跨级时也会执行新版镜像清理逻辑；更新过程只保留当前镜像、
  一代回滚镜像和仍被容器引用的镜像。
- 诊断页改为显示主机磁盘总量、已用、可用空间，以及 MDD 文件、Docker 实际镜像层、容器层
  和构建缓存；不再把共享层重复相加成虚高的“逻辑大小”。
- 系统维护新增可释放空间预估、保守的构建缓存清理，以及可选的旧版/回滚镜像清理。后者会
  明确提示失去一键回滚能力，并始终保护当前镜像、可信基础镜像和容器正在使用的镜像。
- 修复 iPad Safari 横屏时左侧栏无法滚到底部的问题；版本、仓库操作与退出登录现在均可触达。
- 产品介绍和安装文档补充磁盘要求：安装前根分区至少 4 GiB 可用，建议 16 GB 以上系统盘；
  虚拟机扩盘后还必须扩展根分区和文件系统。

## 2. v1.5.0 大版本更新

- 新增“余额与保号”：集中查看线路在线、余额、续费与到期状态，并可按线路类型定时产生真实
  计费事件或监测续费余额。
- 新增语音信箱：无人接听后在网关本机保存留言，并可直接从通话记录播放；默认关闭且支持
  按线路覆盖，主动拒接不会录音。
- 新增未接来电与留言通知；留言通知会替代同一通电话的未接通知，避免重复提醒。
- 新增后台版本检查、Webhook / Telegram / PushPlus 更新通知，以及经过独立许可闸门控制的
  可选自动更新。
- 新增“保持登录 30 天”，登录会话可跨控制服务重启和软件升级继续有效。
- Engine 改为精简的多阶段构建，并加入 Release 镜像的校验、直连/代理回退、进度显示与失败
  回滚，显著减少下载量和系统盘占用。

---

## 0. Important upgrade notes

- **Only for existing v1.4.x amd64 installations using the Docker control plane:** the legacy
  updater requests an ARM64 Control image before the new release can take over. Run this one-time
  compatibility bootstrap on the host, then start the normal update from the WebUI. ARM64,
  native-control, and existing v1.5.x installations do not need it.

  ```bash
  MDD_DATA_DIR=$(sudo sed -n '1p' /etc/mdd-sim-gateway/data-dir)
  test -n "$MDD_DATA_DIR" && test -d "$MDD_DATA_DIR"
  sudo cp -p "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode" "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode.pre-v1.5.3"
  printf 'local\n' | sudo tee "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode" >/dev/null
  ```

  After v1.5.3 takes over, it detects the still-running Docker control plane, downloads the amd64
  Engine and Control images, and restores Docker mode automatically. If the update failed before
  takeover, restore the marker with
  `sudo cp "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode.pre-v1.5.3" "$MDD_DATA_DIR/install-mode"`.

- A first upgrade from v1.4.x or a fresh installation downloads the Engine image for the host's
  architecture; Docker-control installations also download a Control image. On a slow connection,
  “Rebuilding and restarting services” can take several minutes. Do not power off the gateway,
  repeatedly start the update after refreshing, or terminate it manually. Keep about **6 GiB free
  on the root filesystem** before upgrading.
- v1.5.3 does not change the Engine build inputs from v1.5.2. Devices already running v1.5.2 reuse
  their existing Engine and do not recreate lines for this update. Docker-control installations
  still update their Control image.

## 1. v1.5.3 patch update

- Native prebuilt Engine and Control images are now published for both ARM64 and amd64. Official
  installs and one-click upgrades download only the host architecture instead of compiling
  Asterisk or the Docker Control image on the gateway.
- Fixed Issues #17 and #18: cellular SMS sending now works with Ubuntu 22.04 / ModemManager 1.20,
  and canonical ICCID comparison prevents case differences from hiding the correct modem.
- Fixed Issue #19: inserting a new SIM while VoWiFi is disabled no longer leaves its line trapped
  in a draft state that cannot be enabled.
- Fixed Issue #15: the target release now performs image cleanup even on the first upgrade from an
  older updater, retaining only the current image, one rollback generation, and images referenced
  by containers.
- Host diagnostics now separate filesystem total, used and available space from MDD files, actual
  Docker image layers, container layers, and build cache, instead of over-counting shared layers as
  a large logical image total.
- System maintenance now previews reclaimable space and offers conservative build-cache cleanup
  plus optional old/rollback-image cleanup. The latter warns that one-click rollback will be lost
  and always protects current, trusted-base, and container-referenced images.
- Fixed the iPad Safari landscape sidebar so it scrolls to the version, repository actions, and
  sign-out controls.
- Product and installation documentation now states the storage requirement: at least 4 GiB free
  on the root filesystem before installation and a 16 GB or larger system disk recommended. A VM
  disk expansion must also be applied to its root partition and filesystem.

## 2. v1.5.0 feature update

- Added Balance and Number Keeping for line availability, balance, renewal, and expiry status, with
  scheduled real billed activity or renewal-balance monitoring according to the line type.
- Added voicemail stored locally on the gateway and playable from call history after an unanswered
  call. It is off by default, supports per-line overrides, and never records a deliberately declined
  call.
- Added missed-call and voicemail notifications, with a voicemail alert replacing the missed-call
  alert for the same call to prevent duplicate notifications.
- Added background release checks, Webhook / Telegram / PushPlus update notices, and optional
  automatic updates controlled by a separate promotion gate.
- Added “Keep me signed in for 30 days”, with sessions surviving control-service restarts and
  software updates.
- Moved Engine packaging to a smaller multi-stage build and added verified Release images with
  direct/proxy fallback, progress reporting, and failure rollback, substantially reducing download
  and system-disk usage.
